svg.aria-label: Six causal attention masks on 10 queries by 10 keys, query rows and key columns, where only the lower triangle may be filled and the future is masked. Dense causal: every key up to the query, N per query. Sliding window: a band of width 3 on the diagonal. Dilated or strided: every 3rd key back, including the diagonal, about N/3 per query. Window plus global: the band plus the first two key columns filled for every row. Window plus global plus random: the same with a few scattered extra cells. Picked by content: the diagonal plus a few scattered cells per row, different in each row, some far back. Fixed patterns are cheap and predictable, content-picked ones can reach the far token that matters.
svg.text: fixed patterns are cheap and predictable,
content-picked ones can reach the far token that matters
